headline: Bank of Japan Holds Rate While Raising Planned ETF Sales
deck: The central bank kept its overnight call-rate target around 1.25% in an 8–1 vote and set a faster annual ETF-disposal pace from January.
body: The Bank of Japan held its uncollateralized overnight call-rate target around 1.25% in an 8–1 vote. [E3][E6]
Board member Hajime Takata dissented, proposing a target around 1.5% and saying underlying inflation had reached the price-stability target. [E5]
The bank unanimously decided to increase planned annual sales of exchange-traded funds to around ¥860 billion from ¥330 billion at book value, effective January 2027. [E4]
